about: The Today board's command lines (M12.1). Each case is a command line, who typed it, and the op or error `ops::parse` gives; `v1` is what the app answered before the registry.
recorded: v1: a debug build of manager-v2 at 9435ede on a scratch home (HOME and GLASSCODE_HOME), driven over its own control socket on 2026-11-19, a Thursday. “outside”: the glasscode command with no terminal (only reads run; everything else waits for the person, exit 4, and “says” is the approval sentence). “person”: the same through a pty. The board held zysg, rrkh, pgdw and the recurring vkn6; the projects were app and shop.
rules: Never edit a case: a changed golden stops the plan (slice plan section 9). A case without `v1` is a caller the recording could not be. A case with a `note` differs from v1 on purpose, or v1 answered from the app's state.
